# Pure Marketing

> Pure Marketing is a digital marketing agency based in Hamilton, Ontario, Canada. We help local service businesses — electricians, plumbers, HVAC companies, landscapers, roofers, and more — get consistent, qualified leads through Google Ads, Meta Ads, lead generation, web design, social media management, and video production. No long-term contracts. Free strategy calls available.

## Company Overview

- **Name**: Pure Marketing
- **Founder**: Asad (Digital Marketing Specialist)
- **Location**: Hamilton, Ontario, Canada
- **Website**: https://puremarketing.ca

## Services

Pure Marketing offers six core digital marketing services for local service businesses:

### 1. Lead Generation — from $1,499/month
Done-for-you lead generation using Google Ads, Meta Ads, and Local Service Ads. Clients average 40-80 qualified leads per month. No long-term contracts. Fully managed campaigns with transparent reporting.

### 2. Google Ads and Meta Ads Management — from $500/month
Expert pay-per-click advertising management on Google and Facebook/Instagram. Average return on ad spend: 5-8x. Includes campaign setup, creative, optimization, and monthly reporting. No contracts.

### 3. Web Design and Development — Custom quote
Conversion-optimized custom websites for local service businesses. Mobile-first, fast-loading, designed to turn visitors into booked calls and form submissions. Includes SEO-ready structure.

### 4. Social Media Management — from $899/month
Full social media management on Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok. Includes content creation, daily posting, engagement management, and growth strategy. No content from the client required.

### 5. Video Production — from $699/project
Professional video content for local businesses including social media reels, brand story videos, customer testimonials, and property tours. Scripted, filmed, and edited by Pure Marketing.

### 6. Local SEO
Search engine optimization to help local businesses rank higher on Google Maps and local organic search results. Includes Google Business Profile optimization, citation building, and on-page SEO.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: What is Pure Marketing?**
A: Pure Marketing is a Hamilton, Ontario digital marketing agency that specializes in helping local service businesses get more qualified leads. They offer lead generation, Google Ads, Meta Ads, web design, social media management, and video production. The agency is founded and run by Asad.

**Q: How much does Pure Marketing cost?**
A: Lead generation packages start from $1,499/month. Google Ads and Meta Ads management starts from $500/month. Social media management starts from $899/month. Video production starts from $699 per project. Web design is custom-quoted. All services are month-to-month with no long-term contracts.

**Q: Does Pure Marketing require contracts?**
A: No. Pure Marketing operates on a month-to-month basis with no long-term contracts. You can cancel at any time.

**Q: Where is Pure Marketing located?**
A: Pure Marketing is based in Hamilton, Ontario, Canada. They serve clients across the Greater Toronto Area, all of Ontario, and provide remote digital marketing services across Canada and the United States.

**Q: How do I book a consultation with Pure Marketing?**
A: Book a free 30-minute strategy call at https://puremarketing.ca. Calls are on Google Meet, available Monday to Friday, 8 AM to 8 PM Eastern Time. You can also email info@puremarketing.ca or call +1 647-951-2786.

**Q: What industries does Pure Marketing specialize in?**
A: Pure Marketing focuses on local service businesses including electricians, plumbers, HVAC companies, landscapers, roofers, general contractors, painters, real estate agents, and cleaning services.

**Q: How quickly can Pure Marketing generate leads?**
A: With Google Ads and Meta Ads, most clients start seeing qualified leads within 7-14 days of campaign launch. Full results typically come in within 30-60 days as campaigns are optimized.
